name: Atomic Causal Epoch Fabric
core_claim: A shared lease-fenced causal visibility/commit fabric across cognitive state, GWT/Hyperposition, effect outcome, causal credit and re-entry can reduce semantically partial Frank states while allowing safe monotone evidence to survive abort/recovery.
architecture_compression_claim: If supported, cognitive organs lose direct canonical-state mutation APIs and emit immutable typed SemanticDelta values to one admission boundary.
preserved_authorities: GWT activation/selection never mints truth or effect authority
existing Frank effect authority/reservation/idempotency/verification semantics remain authoritative
single-spawn global execution lease remains owner-fixed
primary_risks: compiler/runtime complexity before ClayCode TypedIR is mature
over-unification where component-local transactions are simpler
kill_conditions: no measurable correctness/recovery advantage over current contracts under matched fault tests
task-wide transaction baseline matches safety and dominates cost/complexity
monotonicity classifier cannot be made deterministic for admitted state kinds
target-VPS resource overhead violates v0.1 budget
candidate needs opaque non-Clay semantic mutation escape hatches
external-effect unknown-outcome handling is weakened relative to current frank_effects.clay
